source_coverage: All projects, recorded work, direct costs, issued invoices, payments and credits for the five cases are included through cutoff. One later payment is intentionally included to exercise cutoff handling.
rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP; money per entry to cents; cost uses recorded hours; price uses billing_hours
assumptions: All five projects completed and cost coverage complete at cutoff.
No invoice voiding, reversals, tax, discounts other than CR01, or unrecorded change orders.
Billing links are explicitly confirmed fictional review inputs, not model-inferred matches.
Credit CR01 reduces both P05 pricing basis and I05 balance in their separate calculations.
No guarantee that real vendor CSV exports match these canonical headers.
